```{r setup, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Load dependencies and data
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
df <- read_csv("data/data_for_api_app.csv")

```

```{r first_dropdown, context="sidebar", echo = FALSE}
# First dropdown 
selectInput("provider", "Provider Name",
            choices = sort(unique(df$provider_name)),
            selected = "nytimes.com"
)

```

```{r second_dropdown, context="sidebar", echo = FALSE}
# Second dropdown
renderUI({
  req(input$provider)
  filtered_services <- df |> 
    filter(provider_name == input$provider) |> 
    pull(service_name) |> 
    unique() |> 
    sort()

  default_choice <- if (length(filtered_services) == 1) filtered_services[1] else NULL

  selectInput(
    "service",
    "Service Name",
    choices = filtered_services,
    selected = default_choice
  )
})

```

```{r results, context="sidebar", echo = FALSE}
# Display API information
renderUI({
  req(input$provider, input$service)

  row <- df |> 
    filter(provider_name == input$provider,
           service_name == input$service) |> 
    slice(1)

  tagList(
    tags$img(src = row$url, 
             height = "100px", 
             style = "margin-bottom:1rem;",
             onerror = "this.onerror=null;this.src='www/logo.png';"),
    tags$h3(row$provider_name),
    tags$p(tags$strong("API Name: "), row$service_name),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Preferred Version: "), row$preferred_version),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Description: "), row$description),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Category: "), row$apisguru_category),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Date Added: "), row$added),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Latest Update: "), row$updated),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Spec Version: "), row$openapi_ver),
    tags$p(tags$strong("Format: "), row$format)
  )
})

```
